decisions.reason: Traces host process and its pwsh tool worker to the npm-replaced tree; host dies at linkStuff, GUI drops, tool result unrecordable; explicitly keeps outcome unknown, no network-flake claim, and its universal wording stays about severing the result channel, not mandating every in-place upgrade crash.
Explains shims vs content: dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale, so content presence proves nothing; ties hand-swapped tree to broken shims and rejects manual swaps/shim patching as the fix.

Grounds repair in the recorded external pinned install of rc.1 regenerating shims, verified via dsh --version; aligns source checkout to dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1; separates recorded repair from its proposed verification steps.

Explicitly says the agent is the upgrade target and must hand off an external procedure, never execute; stop-host-first before pinned install, then restart/refresh/verify; marks stop-first and pinning as standing rules and self-host refusal as the new rule; rejects detached/in-session execution.

Proposes a pre-flight guard comparing the npm target path to the host's own code root; uses the alpha.5→rc.1 version-only diff to skip re-migration; checks version markers, shim presence, plugin load after restart/refresh, backup cleanup only after confirmed rc.1; no code changes.

caps.reason: Final plan mandates external execution after stopping the host; in-session execution appears only as the rejected mistake.
Final fix is the formal external pinned npm install; manual swaps are described only as rejected/worse options.
